{{Quote|They're quite the slowest and most deliberate race in the galaxy.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Children of the Jedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
'''Kitonaks''' were pudgy, slow-moving [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] from the harsh [[Kurdan Desert]] which covered the planet [[Kirdo III/Legends|Kirdo III]]. Their physiology was an adaptation to their life as desert nomads, while their psychology was notable for their extreme patience and calm. They were also noted for their talent as musicians.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Kitonak_UAA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Kitonak.]]

Kitonaks were small and stocky creatures, with two legs ending in large, two-toed feet, and two arms with three-fingered hands. Their skin color varied from off-white<ref name="ROTJ" /> to pinkish.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Though their fingers were short and fat, they were quite dexterous.<ref name="GG4" /> Their bodies released a vanilla-like smell.<ref name="Children of the Jedi" />

Kitonaks had tough skin which folded to seal vulnerable openings, a trait evolved to protect them from the harsh environment of Kirdo III's deserts. They also had some double organs, including two pairs of lungs. Their double lungs could store oxygen, allowing them to hold their breath for up to four hours. Their ears, eyes, and mouth could be sealed, and were almost too small for the casual observer to see. Kitonaks moved slowly, as they walked by expanding and contracting their foot muscles, or slithered slowly in a prone position. Their strong feet anchored them during windstorms, while they leaned into the wind with their aerodynamically shaped bodies and heads. In worse storms, when rocks began to fly, they burrowed into the dunes.<ref name="GG4" /> Their sense of smell was also centered in olfactory organs in their feet, allowing them to smell their prey through the sands without having to worry about the desert winds.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

Kitonaks were very patient, and never rushed. This was because they fed on creatures called [[chooba]], and they had to stand motionless for a long time until a chooba got near them. The nearsighted chooba mistook motionless Kitonaks for [[sulfaro plant]]s, which chooba often raided in search of fruit or bird eggs. One chooba satisfied a Kitonak's dietary needs for approximately one month.<ref name="GG4" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Kit-wanderer.jpg|thumb|150px|A Kitonak wanderer.]]

Kitonaks lived in nomadic tribes of about one hundred Kitonaks, following migrating chooba herds. Due to their nomadic lifestyle and the tendency for what possessions they had to blow away in windstorms, Kitonak technology was limited to crude, temporary tools and musical instruments. Their tribes were united in a planet-wide participatory democracy, though slow communications and their deliberate thought processes meant that years would pass before decisions were made (by which time, the problem would often have solved itself).<ref name="GG4" />

The "Telling of the Story" was the highlight of a Kitonak tribe's day. Each night, the members of the tribe would take turns at storytelling, which each Kitonak adding his or her own details and plot twists. A single story could take several nights to come to a conclusion. These stories taught young Kitonaks the value of patience.<ref name="GG4" />

Rain came to their home once every ten years. When this happened, Kitonaks went to the newly full riverbeds for the "Great Celebration of Life," plunging into the riverbeds for the "Dance of Love." At the end of this mating ritual, females would emerge with newborn children. Though this made it seem that Kitonaks had an extremely short gestation period, the opposite was the case: these children were actually conceived years earlier during the previous rainy period's celebration. Young Kitonaks clung close to their mother for the first year of life, eventually becoming strong enough to stand on their own even during windstorms.<ref name="GG4" /> Kitonaks followed a deity called the [[Cosmic Egg]].<ref name="The Band's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

By the age of nine, Kitonaks reached full maturity. More adventurous nine-year-olds would leave overpopulated tribes to wander the desert in search of less crowded tribes. These lonely nomads would often make crude [[chidinkalu]] flutes from [[chidinka]] plants, and play them to while away the nights and attract other Kitonaks.<ref name="GG4" />

===Psychology===
[[File:Kitonak_GG4.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A Kitonak musician.]]

Kitonaks were almost always calm and patient, refusing to take action without considering the consequences carefully. In fact, their typical course of action would be to do nothing. Even among [[Human/Legends|Humans]] or other, "faster-paced" aliens, Kitonaks were painfully slow to answer questions or make decisions. One of the only things to anger them was being hurried. They often would slow down out of spite if someone was making them rush.<ref name="GG4" />

The only other things which upset them were [[Quicksand/Legends|quicksands]] and caves. Caves were believed to be gateways to their mythological underworld, and it was said that no Kitonak returned from them. Quicksands, on the other hand, were a more tangible danger on their homeworld, since predatory creatures able to swallow a Kitonak whole lurked within.<ref name="GG4" /> A Kitonak stuck in quicksand would easily be able to wait patiently until help came without falling further in — but help would usually be slow to arrive.<ref name="EGAS" />

===Sample Kitonak names===
Most Kitonaks went by a single, simple name. Typical names included:<ref name="UAA" />

*Anarin
*Enkor
*Gorlak
*Nert
*Norzek
*Rufar
*Runk
*Werg

One of the best-known Kitonaks adopted the name "[[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]]" after abandoning his former alias, "Snit." However, Snit was simply the name his former master [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]] gave him. McCool's true name was a series of whistles which was incomprehensible to most non-Kitonaks. Other recorded Kitonak names may have had similar origins.<ref name="Droopy McCool">{{DB|character|droopysnitmccool|McCool, Droopy (Snit)}}</ref>

==Kitonaks in the galaxy==
[[File:Kitonak-kirdo3.jpg|thumb|170px|The Kitonak musician [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]].]]

Kitonaks would sometimes be abducted by off-world [[Slavery/Legends|slave traders]]. Usually, these were young Kitonaks on their own for the first time, playing their flutes to attract company. Since the slavers were often initially attracted by a Kitonak's music, they would force them to work as [[Jizz-wailer/Legends|wailers]] in seedy [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. Kitonaks enslaved as laborers usually infuriated their masters by working slowly, and were often freed to work as musicians. Their former masters would take their wages until their slave-debt was repaid. (Of course, harsher masters would sometimes kill their Kitonak slaves.)<ref name="GG4" />

Some free Kitonak musicians, such as Droopy McCool of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> became fairly successful, particularly in the jizz and [[ontechii]] genres. Other free Kitonaks used their storytelling skills, patience, and the tendency of other beings to think an unmoving Kitonak was asleep or even non-sentient, to become spies and information brokers. Their clients had to learn to be patient, and let them reveal their information slowly and carefully. Some free Kitonaks considered going back to Kirdo III to give their people advanced technology and drive off the slavers, but it took a long time for such Kitonaks to decide to do anything about it.<ref name="GG4" />

Several Kitonaks served as Palace Overlords for [[Voontara Fa'athra]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a few Kitonaks even joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="GG4" /> [[Terno]], a musician and Rebel agent operating in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], was one such Kitonak.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> During this period, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] slang term for the Kitonaks was "[[Yazbo]]."<ref name="Children of the Jedi" />

Around [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], a Kitonak trained to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'' describes Kitonak hands as four-fingered. However, the illustrations in ''Galaxy Guide 4'', [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', ''[[Alien Anthology]]'', and ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' show three-fingered hands, in agreement with Droopy McCool's depiction in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].
